errors.means: The server serves no tool by that name; JSON-RPC error -32602 lists the tools it serves in data.tools.
errors.fix: Call one of the names in data.tools, or read tools/list again.

doors.when: First thing in a check-in: the sitter's state, budgets, setup mode and secret names, and whether the Mac itself reports in.

errors.means: The answer's sitter field says action-failed: the sitter didn't answer within 30 s, couldn't run, or exited without a JSON reply.
errors.fix: Check kvm_health for the sitter's heartbeat and the KVM's memory, then call sitter_status again.

errors.means: simulate was given as something other than "stale-heartbeat".
errors.fix: Leave simulate out, or pass "stale-heartbeat" for a drill.

doors.when: Before driving or unlocking: tells which kind of screen is up right now, with a frame id for later hands.

errors.means: The sitter's look or its picture failed: no answer in time, kvmd gave no frame, or the reply wasn't JSON.
errors.fix: Call kvm_health to see whether the sitter is alive, then look again; sitter_screenshot alone may still work.

errors.means: width isn't a number of pixels.
errors.fix: Pass width as a number, such as 1280, or leave it out.

doors.when: When only pixels matter: coordinates to click, a frame id to prove a focused password field, or a sharper image.

errors.means: The sitter took no picture: kvmd didn't give a frame in time, or the sitter's answer had no image.
errors.fix: Check that kvmd shows video (sitter_status shows the last screen read), then take the screenshot again.

errors.means: width isn't a number of pixels.
errors.fix: Pass width as a number between 320 and 1920, or leave it out for 1280.

doors.when: A look shows FileVault or a lock screen and work needs the desktop once, with no standing request.

errors.means: Setup mode is on: the KVM is on another Mac's cables, so the sitter unlocks nothing.
errors.fix: Finish the setup and turn setup mode off with sitter_setup_mode, or wait for it to expire.

errors.means: The sitter tried and the desktop didn't come back, or it refused by its own budget or checks; result says which.
errors.fix: Read result, take a sitter_look to see the screen now, and ask the owner with sitter_notify if it still won't unlock.

doors.when: Before a stretch of UI work lasting minutes, so a Mac that locks midway gets unlocked again by the sitter.

errors.means: unlock_lock_screen is off in this sitter's config, or setup mode is on, so agents can't ask for the desktop.
errors.fix: Ask the owner to set unlock_lock_screen to on_request, or turn setup mode off; sitter_unlock still works for FileVault.

errors.means: The request stands, but this first unlock try didn't bring the desktop back; result.unlock says why.
errors.fix: Take a sitter_look, then retry later or ask the owner with sitter_notify.

doors.when: Last resort for a frozen Mac whose clock stopped and network went quiet; unsaved work on it is lost.

errors.means: No smart plug is configured on this sitter, or setup mode is on, so it cuts no power.
errors.fix: Ask the owner to adopt a plug (housesitter plug <mac> adopt), or turn setup mode off.

errors.means: The sitter refused by its own checks (its power budget, the Mac looking alive) or the plug didn't answer; result says which.
errors.fix: Read result; if the Mac answers after all, leave it, else tell the owner with sitter_notify.

doors.when: The Mac is dark and should be running, such as after a power cut, with its plug or button presser set up.

errors.means: No plug or fingerbot is configured on this sitter, or setup mode is on, so it powers nothing.
errors.fix: Ask the owner to set up a plug or fingerbot, or turn setup mode off.

errors.means: The sitter refused by its own checks or the power device didn't answer; result says which.
errors.fix: Read result, wait a minute and take a sitter_look; tell the owner with sitter_notify if it stays dark.

doors.when: To press on a button, menu or field picked from the latest screenshot, while a desktop is showing.

errors.means: The screen isn't a desktop right now (a password screen, or the menu bar is hidden), so the sitter sends no click.
errors.fix: Unlock with sitter_unlock first, or show the menu bar of a full-screen app, then look and click again.

errors.means: x or y is missing or isn't a number, or w and h aren't numbers.
errors.fix: Pass x and y in the screenshot's pixels, with w and h set to that screenshot's size.

errors.means: kvmd didn't take the mouse event.
errors.fix: Check kvm_health and sitter_status, then click again.

doors.when: To enter ordinary words into the focused field on a desktop: a search, a file name, a terminal command.

errors.means: text is empty, isn't a string, or is over 2000 characters.
errors.fix: Send 1 to 2000 characters, splitting longer text into several calls.

errors.means: The screen isn't a desktop right now, so the sitter types nothing.
errors.fix: Take a sitter_look; unlock with sitter_unlock, or show a full-screen app's menu bar, then type again.

errors.means: kvmd didn't take the keystrokes.
errors.fix: Check kvm_health and sitter_status, then type again.

doors.when: A sudo, Company Portal or Setup Assistant password field sits focused in a recent picture, and the sitter keeps that credential.

errors.means: name, prompt, enter, seen or region is missing or malformed; result names which.
errors.fix: Pass the secret's name, one line of prompt, and seen as the frame id from a screenshot or look.

errors.means: The sitter typed nothing: no such secret, its hourly budget used, an old or changed frame, no live video, or a guarded credential.
errors.fix: Read result: take a fresh screenshot and pass its frame, wait for the budget, or seal the secret with housesitter secret --kvm.

errors.means: The sitter hit an error while checking the picture or typing.
errors.fix: Take a fresh screenshot and try once more; if it fails again, check kvm_health.

doors.when: While setting up a different Mac on the KVM's cables, so the sitter holds back from acting on its own Mac.

errors.means: on is missing, or the sitter refused the hours or mac label it was given.
errors.fix: Pass on: true with mac and hours of at most 24, or on: false.

errors.means: The server couldn't run the sitter's setup-mode command, or it exited with an error; result has its last line.
errors.fix: Check kvm_health, then try again; sitter_status shows whether setup mode is on.

doors.when: When a step waits on a human hand no agent can replace, like approving a sign-in or plugging in a cable.

errors.means: text isn't one line of 1 to 300 characters, holds a secret the sitter keeps, or screenshot isn't true or false.
errors.fix: Send one short line saying what the owner must do, with the number to match, and no secret.

errors.means: The sitter has no notify target, or its 12 an hour are used; result says when one frees up.
errors.fix: Wait for the time in result, or send it over the peer link with peer_send.

errors.means: The notify target refused the message or didn't answer.
errors.fix: Try once more; if it fails again, send it with peer_send.

doors.when: To press a named key or shortcut on a desktop: Return to confirm, Tab to move, cmd+q to quit an app.

errors.means: combo names a key the sitter doesn't know; result names it.
errors.fix: Write keys joined by +, such as cmd+space or return.

errors.means: The screen isn't a desktop, so the sitter presses nothing; Escape is refused there because at a login window it opens the user list.
errors.fix: Take a sitter_look, unlock with sitter_unlock first, then press the key again.

errors.means: kvmd didn't take the key event.
errors.fix: Check kvm_health and sitter_status, then press it again.

doors.when: To bring hidden rows of a list or page into view, by wheel steps, at a point picked from the screenshot.

errors.means: x or y is given but isn't a number, or w and h aren't numbers.
errors.fix: Pass x and y in the screenshot's pixels with w and h set to its size, or leave them all out.

errors.means: kvmd didn't take the wheel event, or dx or dy isn't a number.
errors.fix: Pass dx and dy as numbers of wheel steps, then check kvm_health if it fails again.

doors.when: To tell or ask Ouroboros something in free text, or answer one of its messages by id with re.

errors.means: text is missing or empty.
errors.fix: Pass the message as text.

doors.when: After messages to the Mac go unanswered and its heartbeat or watch says the agent there is down.

errors.means: The server couldn't put the request on its peer queue on the KVM's disk.
errors.fix: Check kvm_health for free space on /userdata, then ask again.

doors.when: To read what Ouroboros wrote since the last check, each new message once, and send what's queued.

errors.means: GitHub didn't answer the read of the inbox gist: the network, the token, or its rate limit.
errors.fix: Try again in a minute; kvm_health shows whether the KVM itself is healthy.

doors.when: On waking, and when the KVM feels slow: whether there's room left for kvmd and the sitter before starting heavier work.

errors.means: A part (mem, load, uptime_min or disk) couldn't be read from /proc or /userdata; that part holds the error.
errors.fix: Read the other parts as usual and call kvm_health again; tell Ari if the same part keeps failing.

errors.means: The sitter field: its status.json is missing or older than three intervals, so nobody unlocks the Mac after a restart.
errors.fix: Tell Ari right away, as the housesitter skill says, and check sitter_status for what it last wrote.
